name: Hull Item
desc: Something that can be installed in a ship's skill tree or hull upgrade sections.

name: Hull Item (for sale)
desc: Something that can be installed in a ship's skill tree or hull upgrade sections.

name: Refit Schematic
desc: Raises a ship's Hull Upgrade points by one when applied in tier order.

name: Master Schematic
desc: Opens one ship's skill tree when Master Schematics are required.

name: Nanite Feedstock
desc: Components recovered by disassembling hull items you no longer need.

name: Augmentation Nanoswarm
desc: Adds one more modifier to a hull item, up to four. A common hull item that gains its third modifier becomes rare.

name: Tuning Nanoswarm
desc: Rerolls the values of every modifier on a hull item within its usual range, or a Doctrine Archive's firmware revision.

name: Annulment Nanoswarm
desc: Removes a random modifier from a hull item or Star Chart. Fixed modifiers are never removed.

name: Metamorph Nanoswarm
desc: Rewrites a unique hull item into a different unique hull item.

name: Fundamental Nanoswarm
desc: Rerolls the values of a hull item's implicit effects within their usual range.

name: Reshaping Nanoswarm
desc: Removes a random modifier from a hull item and rolls a new one in its place. Immutable modifiers are never removed.

name: Immutable Nanoswarm
desc: Makes one random modifier on a hull item immutable. An immutable modifier can't be removed or rerolled. Needs at least two modifiers, and each hull item can only have one.

name: Replicator Nanoseed
desc: Makes a mirrored copy of a hull item. Mirrored items can't be modified or copied again. Replicator Nanoseeds can't be grown.

name: Corrupted Nanoswarm
desc: Corrupts an item, modifying it unpredictably.

name: Prefix Inhibitor
desc: Turned on at the Crafting Bench. The next nanoswarm or cipher that would change existing prefixes leaves them alone. Inhibitors can only be found.

name: Suffix Inhibitor
desc: Turned on at the Crafting Bench. The next nanoswarm or cipher that would change existing suffixes leaves them alone. Inhibitors can only be found.

name: Star Chart
desc: Coordinates to a star system cut off from hyperspace. Opening a wormhole with it uses it up.

name: Reforging Cipher
desc: Rerolls every modifier on a Star Chart at its tier, with its rarity following the new modifier count. Only found inside Star Chart systems.

name: Erasure Cipher
desc: Removes every modifier from a Star Chart. Only found inside Star Chart systems.

name: Cartographer's Cipher
desc: Raises a Star Chart's tier by one, up to tier 15. Only found inside Star Chart systems.

name: Revenant Engram
desc: Rerolls a hull item with four modifiers, one always the Revenant prefix. Only found on corrupted dormant fleets.

name: Wormhole Tech Blueprint
desc: Calibration routines, field geometry and fuel-feed schematics lifted from the Explorarium anchor cache in Limbo. The science teams have spent weeks tracing how the Domain held a wormhole's far end steady, and believe they can build a lattice that does the same for a single set of coordinates. Not a gate. Nothing like one. But it opens.

name: Gateway Array Upgrade
desc: Field readings taken on the far side of a deep chart. The lattice can be retuned to hold coordinates that drift further from known space.

name: Gateway Nexus Upgrade
desc: A full map of how the deepest charts fold. With it, the lattice can hold anything the charts can reach.
